alex: Quick idea — run a small 'quiet launch' webinar next Wed for Dedicated autoscaling. Invitation-only, recorded for partners, no public promo. Want a short run-of-show and a rehearsal plan. Who can help? :wave:
maria: I can host. Keep it 30–35m max. Suggest demo-first, then one customer case, then Q&A. Small panel: me + jamal + ellie.
jamal: happy to do customer case. Can provide metrics (20% cost reduction, 2x throughput) — will prep slides.
ellie: ops ask — will need infra standby and a fallback model if GPU pool is noisy. @ryan can you reserve Dedicated pool for rehearsal + live?
ryan: reserving dedicated pool slot Wed 10:30-12:00 PT. also will put in autoplay fallback policy. tagging ops_bot to create access links.
ops_bot: Access links created: https://console.redwood.ai/dedicated/sessions/quiet-launch-31498 (expires in 72h).
alex: proposed run-of-show:
```
10:55 - lobby
11:00 - intro + goals (3m)
11:03 - demo (12m)
11:15 - customer case (8m)
11:23 - deep-dive Q&A (10m)
11:33 - closing + CTA (2m)
```
Keep tight.
maria: +1. Rehearsal schedule: dry run Tue 9:00 PT (full tech run), podium run Wed 9:30 PT (content only).
jamal: slides due Monday EOD. I'll send a 2-slide summary & data snippet.
ellie: can we add a single backup slide with 'known limits' and fallback steps? Audience likes transparency.
alex: good call. Also need invite list: 30–50 customers + 10 partners. No external ads. @marketing_team — please draft VIP invite copy.
maria: draft will be short, emphasize early access + limited seats. I'll include a short form for content-specific questions.
ryan: will run metrics capture in the demo: latency, tokens/s, cost delta. Need a baseline script — jamal, can you share model configs?
jamal: yes — attaching snippet in thread (will upload slides).
alex: timeline: Mon slides, Tue dry run, Wed live. Post-webinar: send recording + quick best-practice doc. Quick question — record captions? :thinking_face:
maria: yes, add captions. Also 1-pager with benchmarks for attendees.
ellie: legal sign-off on recording & partner names — I'll ping legal.
alex: awesome. Action items:
- jamal: slides + model configs (Mon EOD)
- maria: invite copy + host script (Mon noon)
- ryan: infra reservation + metric script (Mon)
- ellie: legal on recording (ASAP)
- ops_bot: share access links (done)
I'll set calendar invites after materials are in. :rocket:
